executed_binary.reason: Every result reports the model bytes bound to the fit ledger; this does not attest invocation on every query.

fit_query_audit.scope: repository-qualified query-ID overlap against the checkout-reference model, not proof of executed-model disjointness, overfitting or semantic independence

scope_notes: This refresh was measured with a native glibc build on a shared 16-CPU Linux host, not a shipped musl archive or the runner used for the previous report; shared-host load was not isolated, so latency and resource costs are descriptive, not a controlled before/after comparison.

The late dense-fusion calibration used half of the stackoverflow-qa, apps, and codefeedback-mt samples. Zero overlap with the learned reranker's fit ledger does not make those tasks unseen evaluations of the complete ranking stack. CodeSearchNet-python, CodeSearchNet-java, and synthetic-text2sql were not used for that calibration.
